slides.title: Codex can automate editable PPT creation.
slides.subtitle: This sample deck is produced by a local Codex-native workflow.

slides.title: The automation loop is short enough to use every day.
bullets: Keep the deck request in a small JSON brief.
Ask Codex to update that brief or generate a new one.
Run one build command from VSCode or the terminal.
Open the exported .pptx and make final edits in PowerPoint.
slides.asideText: The deck is created with the built-in Codex Presentations runtime, so the result stays editable.

slides.title: A small schema is enough to drive consistent deck output.
slides.takeaway: Once the structure is stable, Codex can generate repeatable first drafts fast.
